title: Runs intermittently
text:
Runs intermittently. Updated Review REDUCED to 2 stars!

After 3 weeks, I realized this fan is not working properly. Even fully charged, it shuts off after 2 minutes. It does this at all 3 speeds. The battery isn't dead, it will restart and run another 2 minutes and then stop. It's made the fan essentially useless.

**** Original review****

We're in the Chihuahua Desert of West Texas and even in early May we've already crossed 101 degrees. Twice. Even with central air, fans are still needed and useful.

This one fits on my bedside table perfectly and anywhere else I want it since it is rechargeable. It adjusts up or down which is quite useful.

I've been quite surprised by how much air this small fan moves. I can feel it 7 feet away on level 2 easily. On level 3, it feels like a much larger fan. I'm really pleased.
